add.text: build_model_metadata in routing_policy.py falls back to the registry's hand-set quality_tier when there is not enough real verification data for a model yet
select_model now calls build_model_metadata on every request, so quality is read at request time instead of once from a dictionary built at import time
log_full_request writes one requests row, one model_calls row per model call (more than one only if escalation happened) and one quality_scores row per verified call
